title: Bean seeds sown to beans picked
checked: Every reachable state checked (8 states, 21 with their data, 32 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 8 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
The plants still growing and the ones on the compost always add up to the 40 seeds in the packet.

rules.rule: No picking from a bare bed
rules.says: The basket fills only when at least one plant is left.
rules.path: Take away the some plants left guard and it breaks in 9 steps: next stage, next stage, next stage, next stage, next stage, slugs in the night, slugs in the night, slugs in the night, next stage.
